learning: Tests whether line_loss_events goes to zero when the detection radius of the outer sensors reaches about 0.07 m. If it does not, the loss is controller-side (line_loss handling or start position), not geometric.
notes: Builder's ±0.05 m span with 16 mm footprints, paired with a controller whose outer weights are scaled to the sideways positions (±1.5 at x = ±0.05 m). Gains are the damped iteration 2 set (kp 2.5, kd 0.2), since kp 3.0 raised oscillation in iteration 1.
rationale:
Evidence: iteration 2 (16 mm footprint, sensors at x = ±0.03 m) still logged one line-loss event on the oval and S-bend and ended every run off_track at max_error about 0.0605 m. Iteration 1 (12 mm footprint, same span) showed the same pattern, with 2 losses on the oval. Changing only the footprint did not close the gap, so the span is the binding lever. The Builder's geometry sets outer sensors at x = ±0.05 m. With a 16 mm footprint and 12.5 mm tape half-width, a sensor sees tape while the centre offset is within about 0.0205 m of its x, so the outer sensors stop seeing tape at about 0.0295 m offset and the centre sensors (x = 0) still cover |offset| up to 0.0205 m. The 0.0205 m detection radius of the centre sensors is the limit that matters, because the outermost detector covers offsets out to about 0.07 m. Mass 0.7 kg, wheel_track 0.10 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m and body_width 0.12 m are held as the Builder specified, so this race isolates the span effect.

Controller: the sensors are unevenly spaced in the sense that the outer pair sits at ±0.05 m, so I scale each weight to its sideways position: x/0.05 × 1.5 gives [-1.5, -1.05, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.05, 1.5]. This keeps the signal monotonic in the sensor's lateral position and keeps the full-scale weight at ±1.5, the same as iteration 2, so the signal magnitude is not inflated. Gains are carried over from iteration 2 (kp 2.5, kd 0.2, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.3) because that is the most damped setting tested. Iteration 1 showed that kp 3.0 raised oscillation to 0.186 and max_error to 0.068 m, so I do not raise kp. The risk is that the outer sensors read zero near centre, so the centre sensors carry the signal there. line_loss stays at last_direction. Expected: line_loss_events at 0 on all development tracks if the threshold model holds; if it does not, the next step is a controller-side fix, not more span.
